121001.Desc: Platinum light suddenly bursts forth, and a vortex ring engraved with ancient remnants quietly takes shape. Water energy is drawn in from all directions, as though a preexisting technique has been reawakened.
121001.Name: Vortex Summoning Stance

123901.Desc: A black meteor falls like myth itself, whispering, murmuring, striking like a crow and raising winds of dread.
123901.Name: Gravistar Field

124101.Desc: The laser bursts from the top of the staff, intertwining cherry blossoms and twilight into a beam of light, like the Crimsonthread of Amaterasu's loom cast into the mortal world.
124101.Name: Radiant Falling Petals

124201.Desc: Ice crystals gather at the staff's tip like blood-red cherry blossoms, finally exploding into thorn-like icicles. The forbidden prayers of a divine sorceress can be faintly heard amidst the cold air.
124201.Name: Vermilion Spell

124401.Desc: By drawing on the power of platinum remnants, the chill is condensed to its limit before being unleashed in a crushing surge. A storm suddenly bursts forth, with ice and wind overlapping and swirling. Everything within reach is brought to a standstill.
124401.Name: Frozen Glint Stance

124601.Desc: Thought and meditation converge into a storm that sweeps with annihilating force.
124601.Name: Meditative Storm

141801.Desc: The spear thrust is too fast to see its physical form. Only afterimages like a hailstorm of cherry blossoms explode in the air can be seen, as if bombarding continuously with the entire spring as ammunition.
141801.Name: Petal Storm

141901.Desc: A diving spear attack from high above tears through the clouds. Upon landing, it kicks up a ring-shaped shockwave of cherry blossoms. Cicada-wing-shaped energy fragments hover and flicker at the epicenter of the blast.
141901.Name: Cicada Flash

142101.Desc: Flowing mist gathers at the tip of the spear, allowing the platinum power to resonate to its limit. The bindings are then released, unleashing a spiral capable of shredding space itself.
142101.Name: Void-Shattering Storm

142401.Desc: All skill is poured into the spear point during the ride of the wind into the air. Platinum remnants flash. Where the gale blows is where destiny meets its end.
142401.Name: Where the Gale Blows

143001.Desc: A summoned wind ring denies all. No wing crosses. Only plumes remain.
143001.Name: Stillwind

143101.Desc: A vaulting lance lifts the night. On impact, it rends the sky, with black light flooding earth as feathers erupt in praise.
143101.Name: Orbit Crash

150701.Desc: The healing aura ripples out like water waves, pink petals continuously falling within its range. The bloodstains of the injured are gently dyed the color of wilting cherry blossoms.
150701.Name: Crimson Halo

151801.Desc: The moment the spell ring rotates, thorny vines erupt from the void. Cherry blossom branches transform into a strangling cage of thorns for the enemy, each leaf blade stained with a thin layer of red blood-dew.
151801.Name: Emerald Vines

152001.Desc: Dark energy hidden in the spell ring erupts like bullets, wreathed in black light and shedding dark feathers.
152001.Name: Umbral Surge

152101.Desc: Overlooking the decay from above, the obsession known as healing is turned into a prayer. The power of ancient remnants swirls and surges, and this wish, born from the thirst for continuation, will ultimately bloom into the breath of revival.
152101.Name: Breath of Revival

152301.Desc: As chaotic vitality awakens a healing resonance, the power of platinum remnants intertwines and condenses. It transforms into the palpitation of all things reborn, soothing all pain.
152301.Name: Resurrection

152901.Desc: Night grants its chosen ground. All who enter are blessed.
152901.Name: Domain of Night

160501.Desc: A flurry of slashes is unleashed at will. Arcs of light sweep through a sky full of falling cherry blossoms around you, as intense and as fleeting as fireworks.
160501.Name: Skyward Sparks

160601.Desc: In a moment of slightly restrained sharpness, the Dual Axes swing down abruptly. Cherry blossoms bloom along their path, unfurling into a skyward sea of flowers before scattering with the wind in a flash.
160601.Name: Instant Edge Blossom

160801.Desc: Wrath transforms into an endless barrage of cleaves. Axe blades carve through the air as light and shadow intertwine; void-rending blade echoes coil around the wielder, nearly consuming all. When the decisive strike lands, heaven and earth fall silent, and all wrath converges into a single blade.
160801.Name: Wrath Into the Void

161201.Desc: With the body as the axis, long-accumulated power of severance is unleashed. The platinum arcs blooming from the Dual Axes weave a funereal cocoon around nearby enemies.
161201.Name: Funereal Cocoon

161301.Desc: Wrath surges to its limit, the body becoming a raging tide that devours all. The blade incarnate—everything shatters in its wake. All clamor is silenced within this frenzied dance that rends the void, fading into oblivion.
161301.Name: All-Ending Oblivion

161601.Desc: The power of severance is pushed to its absolute limit, and the Dual Axes are crossed in a sweeping strike that releases a death-knell wail. Where the platinum scars burst open, the power of ancient remnants is fully revealed, cutting off all paths of retreat.
161601.Name: Wail of Severance

171401.Desc: A faint light, like the cold moon, flows along the blade. The moment the Iaido Slash lands, camellia petals and frost shatter together, like a phantom wilting in the night mist.
171401.Name: Luminous Tsubaki

171501.Desc: The dual slashes of the dash tear through the air, Crimsoncherry blossoms burning out along their trajectory, like two red swallows streaking across the battlefield, leaving only scorching ashes and scattered flower souls.
171501.Name: Swallow Counter

171701.Desc: A gleam rides the edge, slicing the night's feathers and vanishing through split-second malice.
171701.Name: Shadowflash

171801.Desc: A single swing of the blade produces countless slashes of light. As the strikes unfold, the power of ancient remnants flows like swift clouds, weaving into an unbroken stream of platinum blade shadows. Slaughter is not the swordsman's intent, but rather a reflection of a clear will.
171801.Name: Clear Flow

171901.Desc: When the swordsman's mind aligns with the sword, the blade is no longer bound by form—it can be an edge, a spike, or a scythe. Platinum power permeates the sharp edge, ensuring that even the most stubborn defense will be broken by the slash.
171901.Name: Formless Flow

172401.Desc: Steel shines by night, chaining strikes into desire. Even crows hush, moonlight gilding the black in a wordless waltz.
172401.Name: Thornspire Waltz

192201.Desc: The blade is entwined with an ominous storm of cherry blossoms. Each spinning slash unleashes a crimson tide, as if an ogre is smashing an entire cherry forest down upon the mortal world.
192201.Name: Cherry Cleaver

192401.Desc: The platinum remnants manifest as the Guard Blade surges forward like a shifting mountain. This strike eliminates any room for retreat, crushing forward with an unshakable momentum.
192401.Name: Mountain-Crushing Dash

192501.Desc: Wrath amasses gloom then falls as a curtain. Stone sentinels rising to undo all schemes.
192501.Name: Nightfall Suppression

192701.Desc: The suppressed battle intent bursts forth, and its momentum surges like waves. Wherever the platinum remnant emerges, all dust and stone congeal, transforming into a protective boundary.
192701.Name: Bloodthirst Realm Protector

193001.Desc: The moment the giant blade smashes into the ground, rubbles and cherry petals burst out together. Boiling crimson flower mud surges from the fissures of the cracked ground.
193001.Name: Mountain-Toppling Cherry

193701.Desc: A titanic slam hurls boulders skyward. Black rocks rain down, terrifying the weak.
193701.Name: Bulwark Forcefield

222001.Desc: The moment the bowstring twangs, multiple arrows, wrapped in a downpour of cherry blossoms, are unleashed. Each arrow blooms into a small crimson vortex along its flight path.
222001.Name: Sakura Maelstrom

222201.Desc: The arrowheads transform into an unceasing meteor shower of cherry blossoms. The dense barrage makes an unending crimson snow fall from the sky.
222201.Name: Floral Hailstorm

223001.Desc: Ravens calls and feathers answer as weapons, guarding all beneath the dark.
223001.Name: Meteor Annihilation

223201.Desc: The shadow of the arrow splits into countless platinum afterglows in mid-air, accompanied by the emergence of ancient remnants. In the next instant, light arrows descend like a torrential downpour.
223201.Name: Storm of Light Arrows

223301.Desc: The fingertips act before the mind, and the arrowhead leaves the string in a fleeting moment. A light arrow, reflecting the glow of remnants, tears through the air, reducing all obstacles to dust.
223301.Name: World-Piercing Arrow

223401.Desc: Black feathers fire as arrows, ripping the sky and leaving shadows to fade as they pin the battlefield.
223401.Name: Blackcloud Barrage

230601.Desc: As you leap and slash, your guitar bursts with brilliant sakura sound waves. The entire sakura forest whirls with each strike. Sound and blade intertwine into a melody of Season Passion.
230601.Name: Hanami Frenzy

230701.Desc: With a gentle pluck of the strings, pale pink petals drift with the notes. The soft melody turns into a healing light, easing your allies' pain.
230701.Name: Sakura's Touch

230801.Desc: This is the moment—the beat in the mind has already taken over the motor nerves. In the face of this soundwave, even breathing out of rhythm is a transgression! Go on, press all those off-beat emotions straight into the strings... LISTEN UP, YOU PUNKS! This is a power chord straight from the pull of gravity!
230801.Name: Gravity's Power Chord

230901.Desc: Music becomes medicine: rock anthems thunder through the sky, bolstering allies and casting away their wounds.
230901.Name: Soul Rock

231201.Desc: Does quietness signify maturity? No, it means the party's over... and I absolutely refuse to let that happen. Put away those soft little tunes and get back to the noise! In the melody of the platinum wave—NO! ONE! EVER! STOPS!
231201.Name: Restless Sweep

231301.Desc: Strings ignite forbidden notes, a black tide swells as feathers dance along the rhythm, witnessing a song no world dares forget.
231301.Name: Unchained Sound

240501.Desc: Cherry blossoms entwine into an eightfold illusion. The moment of impact, ice crystals and petals explode into a hailstorm, carving a bloody falling blossom emblem onto the enemy.
240501.Name: Octave Snowfall

240601.Desc: The slash of the blade cuts open the night curtain. Cherry blossoms rapidly grow and then wilt along the sword mark, as if drawing a final "One" on the battlefield with a crimson ink brush.
240601.Name: Sakura Ichimonoji

240801.Desc: Protective conviction is gathered and released in a spinning throw. The platinum remnants continue to whirl, forming a wall of light shields. Wherever its radiance reaches, evil is held at bay.
240801.Name: Conviction Loop

241201.Desc: A sweeping blade cuts through the wind of night, the Ring of Edict purges all lurking in the shadows, as the greatsword vanishes back into darkness.
241201.Name: Edict Ring

241901.Desc: A shield woven of black light stands unbroken, anchored at your side like an unassailable bastion.
241901.Name: Unfallen Bastion

242101.Desc: The blade is raised high, and the vow echoes loudly. The undying conviction is manifested through the power of ancient remnants. It serves both as a sharp blade to pierce through illusions and an unbreakable shield for steadfast defense.
242101.Name: Oath Judgment
